from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code/security code")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    line_item_name: str = Field(description="The exact line item name for non-current assets, e.g., '非流动资产合计'")
    non_current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="Total non-current assets amount in yuan")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt anchoring the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
